answer: A mechanism that actually bites: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because sonnet only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, canyon is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any zephyr approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
